subject: Ephemeral logs & runtime snapshot for HarborBank executive escalation
messages:
From: Lisa Tan <lisa.tan@harborbank.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Miles <cto@harborbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T22:13:00Z
Subject: High error rate / exec flagged — need secured runtime evidence

Ben —

We're seeing a sustained spike in 5xx error rate and end-to-end latency impacting a small subset of our payment flows (trace IDs attached in the sample). The CEO has asked for a short briefing and an evidence bundle that explains what telemetry we still have and whether any prompt / customer data might be present in logs.

Can you confirm:
- What ephemeral artifacts you can pull from the runtime (prefix/KV cache snapshots, in-flight request traces, per-worker stderr/stdout).
- Whether those artifacts include any PII or full prompt text.
- A secure way for you to deliver them to us and for us to verify authenticity (hashes, signed manifest).

Attached: harbor_sample_requests.log.txt (examples of affected requests). We need initial confirmation within 60 minutes — exec attention is high.

Thanks,
Lisa Tan
Director, Ops
HarborBank

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tan <lisa.tan@harborbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T22:29:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate / exec flagged — need secured runtime evidence

Lisa — thanks for the heads up and the sample traces. We’ve triaged the signals and opened an incident room. Quick answers up front:

- Artifacts we can capture immediately: per-request traces (jaeger spans / trace IDs), worker stderr/stdout logs, aggregated router metrics, and a point-in-time runtime snapshot containing active KV cache keys (metadata only). We cannot export encrypted tenant keys or raw HSM secrets.
- Prompt text: some of the request logs can include prompt snippets; by default we redact full prompt bodies in operational logs, but sample traces sometimes include trimmed payloads. We will run an automated redaction pass before sharing.
- Delivery: we will stage a signed manifest and a read-only, short-lived (24h) presigned S3 link scoped to HarborBank’s requesters. The manifest will include SHA256 hashes for the artifacts and a signing stamp from our security key.

Proposed immediate plan (t+2h):
1) Capture point-in-time runtime snapshot and gather the listed artifacts.
2) Run redaction script (see marissa's note below) to remove prompt bodies and any detected card-like numbers; create manifest.
3) Share presigned S3 URL + manifest + verification instructions with HarborBank and legal.

If HarborBank requests a stricter chain of custody or notarized handoff we can engage security/legal — please indicate.

I’ll push the first snapshot in ~90 minutes unless you ask us to accelerate.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Tan <lisa.tan@harborbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T23:05:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate / exec flagged — need secured runtime evidence

Adding technical detail and checklist for capture (ops playbook excerpt):

Artifacts we will collect (ordered):
- router-metrics-20270524T22:00-22:30.jsonl (per-route counters, aggregated 1s)
- worker-stderr-<node-id>-20270524T22:13.log (rotated)
- jaeger-traces-harbor-20270524-2213.zip (spans for supplied trace IDs)
- runtime_snapshot_metadata-20270525.json (list of active caches + sizes; NO raw KV values)

Redaction steps (automated pipeline):
- Prompt bodies: replace with token-length placeholders (e.g., <REDACTED_PROMPT_LEN=23>)
- Numeric heuristics: mask 13–19 digit sequences unless whitelisted (we will provide a masked manifest)
- Hash verification: compute SHA256 on each artifact and include hex in the manifest

Security controls for transit:
- Artifacts uploaded to a customer-scoped, encrypted S3 bucket under a temporary prefix. Links will be pre-signed for 24h.
- Audit logs for the snapshot extraction will be retained and included (which user/agent ran the export, timestamps, XSRF token ids).

Attachments I’ll include with the handed-off bundle: requested_artifact_manifest.csv, redaction_rules.txt, and a brief readme with verification steps.

Note: we can also perform a live screen-share walk-through with HarborBank security if they prefer not to receive raw artifacts.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Tan <lisa.tan@harborbank.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Miles <cto@harborbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T02:11:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate / exec flagged — need secured runtime evidence

Thanks Ben/Marissa. That plan sounds reasonable. A few clarifications from our compliance team:
- We need a clear statement in the manifest about whether any raw prompt text remained in the artifacts you will hand off. If redaction is automated, please include the redaction log and the exact regex/heuristic rules applied.
- HarborBank legal wants the SHA256 hashes and the raw manifest signed by a named Redwood approver. Can you confirm who will sign and the expected delivery time?
- For chain verification, we prefer a short-lived, read-only URL plus a signed email (PGP or DocuSign confirmation is fine).

We approve the screen-share option if that reduces risk of prompt exposure; please advise cost/availability.

Lisa

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tan <lisa.tan@harborbank.com>, Aaron Miles <cto@harborbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: High error rate / exec flagged — need secured runtime evidence

Lisa/Aaron — final confirmation and next steps: we completed the capture and redaction pass at 09:05Z. Deliverables and process: 

What we uploaded:
- runtime_snapshot_20270525.tar.gz (metadata + rotated logs; prompt bodies replaced with <REDACTED_PROMPT_LEN=n>)
- requested_artifact_manifest.csv (artifact names, sizes, SHA256)
- redaction_rules.txt (exact heuristics used)

Security & verification:
- Presigned S3 link (24h): https://s3.redwood/temp/harbor/20270525 (access audited)
- Manifest signed by Evelyn Hart (Head of Security Ops) — signature file included in the bundle.
- Audit note: extraction was performed by marissa_cole with run-id export-20270525-09-05; export activity is in our internal audit log (link: https://drive.redwood/company/HarborBank/incident-20270525).

If HarborBank prefers a live walkthrough rather than downloading artifacts we can schedule a secure screen share for this afternoon. Otherwise we will wait for confirmation that the presigned link has been received and verified before we delete the temporary prefix.

Attachments in this thread: runtime_snapshot_20270525.tar.gz; requested_artifact_manifest.csv; redaction_rules.txt; signature_evelyn_hart.sig

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
